definition: Strict OOF residuals are target minus inner-CV-selected SPOT_ONLY outer-fold predictions. Residual correction is evaluated only on F2/F3; training labels are earlier outer-fold OOF residuals (F1 for F2; F1+F2 for F3). This intentionally sacrifices F1 evaluation rather than train on in-sample residuals.
features: derivative lags t-5..t, frozen derivative innovations/interactions, and frozen calendar controls; no spot features.
